articles.headline: Teenage Argentine player Camilo Nuin dies during knee surgery
articles.description: Camilo Nuin, an 18-year-old player for Argentina second division team San Telmo, died on Wednesday during knee surgery.

articles.headline: Fireworks fest during game in Argentina's 2nd division
articles.description: Independiente Rivadavia fans celebrate with fireworks their 2-1 win over Deportivo Maipu.

images.name: Fireworks fest during game in Argentina's 2nd division
images.caption: Independiente Rivadavia fans celebrate with fireworks for their 2-1 win over Deportivo Maipu.

articles.headline: Argentine player Rodrigo Espindola dies in home invasion
articles.description: Second-division Argentine player Rodrigo Espindola is dead after a home invasion on the outskirts of Buenos Aires.

articles.headline: River's Matias Kranevitter eyes 'dream' Barcelona final before Atletico move
articles.description: The 22-year-old Argentina midfielder wants to end his River Plate career with a Club World Cup win against Barcelona before joining up with Atletico.
